'created_at and modified_at are managed by the device registry itself, and passing them to DeviceRegistry.async_get_or_create never had any effect -- the values were ignored. Simply drop the arguments.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9, so there is no replacement field: delete the argument. Only the DeviceInfo(...) and async_get_or_create(...) call forms are matched; a plain dict literal {"created_at": ...} is not, because nothing in the file proves it is device info.

Reads DeviceRegistry.deleted_devices. 'deleted_devices is an internal implementation detail of the device registry, and the whole attribute is now deprecated -- there is no supported public use. Accessing it in any way is deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9. There is no replacement: a deleted device is registry bookkeeping, so the read has to go. Reported only where the receiver is proven to be a DeviceRegistry.

Uses DeviceRegistry.devices as a mapping. 'Using it as a mapping -- subscription, .get(), .values(), .keys(), or membership by device id (device_id in registry.devices) -- is deprecated.' Removed in Home Assistant Core 2027.9.
